record.question: On a sono-mammogram, how does a simple, benign breast cyst typically appear?
options: As a solid, irregularly shaped mass.
As a hyperechoic (bright) mass with posterior shadowing.
As a circumscribed, anechoic (black) lesion with posterior acoustic enhancement.
As a heterogeneous, solid mass with indistinct margins.
record.explanation: Answer C: As a circumscribed, anechoic (black) lesion with posterior acoustic enhancement.. A simple cyst is typically anechoic, circumscribed, and shows posterior acoustic enhancement. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mammo; https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
